newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia govt paper mkt value rises to 301 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Russia govt paper mkt value rises to 301 trln rbls.

text.p: The market value of Russian government securities rose to 300.89 trillion roubles ($52 billion) on July 18 from 300.34 trillion roubles on July 11, the central bank's open market operations department said on Monday.
The market value of GKO discount Treasury bills fell to 245.77 trillion roubles from 248.14 trillion roubles, the central bank said in a statement.
The market value of OFZ interest-bearing bonds rose to 55.12 trillion roubles from 52.19 trillion roubles, it said.
The nominal value of government securities rose to 316.91 trillion roubles from 315.63 trillion roubles, the statement said.
